name: affixio-mcp
description: Local stdio MCP wrapping the affixio SDK. Host-side ACTION attestation with attest_action, verify_action, and gate_tool_call. PII stays on the host; not KYC. Works offline with defaults. Optional client env (set only if needed): AFFIX_API_KEY (default local_operator), AFFIX_MCP_HOME (default ~/.affix-mcp).

npm.description: Run AffixIO local ACTION attestation MCP via npx

tools.name: attest_action
tools.description: Create a signed host-side ACTION attestation

tools.name: verify_action
tools.description: Verify an ACTION attestation or receipt

tools.name: gate_tool_call
tools.description: Allow or deny a privileged tool call with a signed decision
